title: The spare key
brief: A quiet mystery. Let the sound at the door interrupt a private thought.
summary: Mara waits in the hall with a key nobody was supposed to have.
ending: The locked door opens from the other side. The visitor is not yet visible.

characters.name: Mara
characters.design: Tall, angular silhouette; warm brown skin, square glasses, short charcoal curls. Boxy rust jacket over cream overalls; brass key pinned to the left lapel. Restrained hand movements.

environments.name: Service hallway
environments.design: Locked-off front view. Blue plaster back wall; green service door on the right, pivot on its right jamb. Warm lamp lights the left third. Floor line y=1500; thin foreground sill leaves Mara unobstructed.

beats: Mara stands left of the shut door, her brass key in the lamplight. Beyond the door, two approaching heels tap the tile and stop. Mara's own feet stay planted.
On the missing third step, Mara looks right at the handle. Her brows draw together. We hear her thought close and clear above the distant vent; her lips stay closed.
Hold on her eyes and the still handle as the question ends. No answering step; the vent is the only sound left.
The door eases ajar on the right. A thin hinge squeal breaks the quiet, then catches and stops. Mara doesn't move.
Hold on the black gap. A low, wordless human tone swells behind the room sound, then fades. Cut before a face appears.
scenes.ambience: Night interior, distant ventilation fan through a ceiling grille, soft steady motor hum with a faint hollow tile reflection; no footsteps, speech or door sounds

sfx.prompt: Two leather heel taps on tile beyond a closed door, half a beat apart; first muffled, second slightly nearer, short hollow reflection, then an abrupt stop
One dry metal hinge taking weight slowly, quiet onset rising to a thin squeal, catching short as the door stops; close, with a small tiled-room echo
Single distant low human vowel, breathy and wordless, swelling softly out of room tone then fading to air; an uneasy accent, no lyrics or instruments
